info.name: Kreavana Backend API (Fixed)
info.description:
Postman collection for Kreavana backend API.
Set {{baseUrl}} to your API host, e.g. http://localhost/api.
Set {{baseUrlRoot}} to your web host, e.g. http://localhost.
After a successful login, the token is saved automatically to {{authToken}} for later requests.
